Factual record & care

Material provenance monograph

Everyday Care · CJ
“Rooted in domestic ritual — separated clearly from medicinal or brightening claims.”
Curcuma longa · Plantation Plate

Fresh rhizome colour paired with a plain solid cleansing formulation; therapeutic wording is withheld prior to full safety review.

This partner listing introduces facial turmeric cleansing pads stocked and fulfilled externally through CJ rather than through OPAR's own invoice checkout. By keeping partner offers separate from house stock, OPAR makes clear who holds inventory, sets live pricing, and handles after-sales support.

Pre-soaked facial pads are listed for quick routine cleansing at home or in travel kits. Because OPAR does not fulfil or repackage this item, current pad counts, INCI declarations, and shipping destinations should always be checked on the linked CJ page before completing any transaction.

OPAR publishes zero medicinal or clarifying skin claims on partner cards and never captures card or checkout details for external offers.

Care & handling

Check the external merchant's lid-sealing and temperature storage guidance on the CJ listing page, and review the full ingredient panel before facial use.
